decisions.reason: The four-week warm-up duration does not change the registered domain, registrar, or domain-registration obligation.
Domain warm-up duration does not change the web-forwarding destination or behavior.
The source establishes warm-up timing and subscription duration, not a change to Gmail compatibility or mailbox setup.
The one-month subscription refers to the domain warm-up tool, not the MeetAlfred Pro subscription or configuration.
The warm-up subscription duration does not alter the Zapier Pro plan, add-on choice, or integration configuration.
Although domain warm-up may precede email campaigning operationally, the source does not change the deferred campaign's channel, automation mode, platform, or lifecycle.
Domain email warm-up timing does not affect the LinkedIn campaign's automation behavior or platform.
The source does not change the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization method or lifecycle.
Warm-up duration does not change the restrictions on using production leads or the preferred test identity.
The source does not alter the obligation to preserve the existing MeetAlfred integration and campaigns.
Domain warm-up timing does not modify the deferred silent-lead follow-up workflow or campaign-cleanup rule.
The one-month warm-up subscription is unrelated to the HubSpot Starter subscription and CRM configuration.
